title: A Companion module in the Skillfully plugin store
description: An entry points at a Bitfocus Companion module's own source at one exact commit. It may also answer, in advance, some of the questions a hub would otherwise ask its superuser before the module reaches anything. The module's code is never copied into this repository.

id.description: The module's own id, as its manifest gives it. The file is named <id>.json.

name.description: What a person would call the device.

description.description: One or two plain sentences on what it does.

commit.description: The full commit, never a branch or a tag: those can move.

network.description: What a hub should allow this module without asking. A hub asks its superuser before a module reaches anything; whatever is listed here has been judged safe to allow for everyone. A part in braces is filled from the module's own settings, for example {host}:9999, meaning the address the team types in. Leave out anything a team should decide for themselves. lan and listen are wide and need a reason in notes.

settings.description: Settings to start the module with, where its own defaults make it reach for more than it needs.

tested.description: How far this has been proven. starts: it runs in the sandbox and describes itself. pretend-device: it drove a stand-in that speaks the device's protocol. real-device: someone used it with the real thing.

notes.description: Why it needs what it asks for, and anything a team should know.
